scope: Selected recent national generic congressional ballot polls verified against primary publishers. Not an exhaustive feed or polling average.
notes: A national generic ballot poll measures party preference, not a district winner or probability of House control.
Retain raw reported shares and population labels. RV and LV polls have different target populations.
Two YouGov waves are shown for context; they must not be treated as independent pollsters.
Margins of error apply to individual estimates. They are not automatically uncertainty bounds on party margins, predictions, or seat counts.
Percentages are rounded and may not add to 100.

Angus Reid Aug 8–11 (release Aug 27) found 45D/36R before decided-voter normalization and 53D/43R among decided voters. Tables downloaded separately; excluded from normalized poll list because subgroup denominator requires more reconciliation.
